_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); railroad signals

pit_profile.why: Union Pacific: the largest railroad in North America, covering 23 states across the western two-thirds of the US, with BNSF its main rail competitor on parallel routes; carload volume follows the industrial economy, the franchise does not

classification.quality_note: Union Pacific: the largest railroad in North America, covering 23 states across the western two-thirds of the US, with BNSF its main rail competitor on parallel routes; carload volume follows the industrial economy, the franchise does not. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 2.61x; +44% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.17; conservative 2yr -5%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -29.0%/yr (worst year FY03-FY13, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +8.4%/yr (Q4 2013 revenue + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +16.6%/yr (FY03-FY13 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +42.6%/yr (best 2-yr run FY03-FY13); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: UNP (retrospective, 2014-02-07) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 2.61x (65.0% downside to Bear $62 / +24.9% upside to Bull $221) | Adj composite 2.72 vs market 2.89: gap -0.17 [FAIRLY VALUED] | +44% above the EPP floor $122 (13x FY14E $9.42) | Conservative 2-yr case: -5.3% total (-2.7%/yr) | At 18.8x FY14E the 15% hurdle price $234 sits above the BULL case; carloads +2% in Q4 2013, forward revenue +7% (no FY14 revenue guide, Q4 2013 freight revenue); no disruption theme has dated evidence.

sources.title: Union Pacific Corporation FY2012 10-K
sources.supports: selected financial data 2008-2012 (diluted EPS 2008 $4.53, 2009 $3.74, 2010 $5.53, 2011 $6.72, 2012 $8.27; 2012 operating ratio 67.8%); 2012 diluted shares 476.5M, effective tax rate 37.6%, interest expense $535M, other income $108M, free cash flow $1,382M; 13,804,709 shares repurchased in 2012; competition (BNSF parallel routes); 2013 Outlook in words only (volume to exceed 2012 levels if industrial production grows about 2%, earnings to exceed 2012 earnings even with no volume growth); capital investments of about $3.6 billion
